frozen.question: HOW FAST does today's world react, per surprise class, per role, per channel — and WHERE would a latency law have to bite? INSTRUMENT-ONLY.
frozen.arm: ⭐ THE v7 WORLD: `new Match({...a4MatchFlags(7)})` + `armA4World(m, null, 7, poolT1DoseCells(L3-T1))`, asserted LIVE on every walked match (ruling #283 item 2 — League.toJSON omits matchFlags, so a fixture-simmed match would NOT be this world).

clockConvention.statement: ⭐ EVERY lag in this artifact is APPLIED TICKS on the SIM clock. k = 1 means "the first executor call after the step in which the event became observable".
clockConvention.whyNotScoreboard: the 22.5× scoreboard mapping is display-only; body physics (and therefore reaction) lives on the sim clock — PC contract §2 M-PC.1.

channelDefinitions.steer: the per-tick truth-tracking STEERING channel. lag = the first tick k ≥ 1 at which `interceptBall(body_k, LIVE ball_k).point` differs by > 0.05 m from `interceptBall(body_k, the ball FROZEN at the pre-event tick).point`. The engine's OWN function is called on both sides — no formula is copied. APPLICABLE only while the body is in the intercept family (ChaseBall not containing / ReceivePass / InterceptPass); the applicability denominator is published per face.
channelDefinitions.decide: the DECISION-SLOT channel. lag = the first tick k ≥ 1 at which this body's `decisionTimer` was ≤ 0 entering the step, i.e. the first tick he re-decides.
channelDefinitions.action: the ACTION channel. lag = the first tick k ≥ 1 at which `p.action.type` or `p.action.targetIdx` differs from what it was at the event. Censored at the horizon; the share that changed at all is published beside the mean.

frozen.pressedSplitDefinition: an EVENT is PRESSED when an opponent of the initiator is within TOUCH_CONTROL_DIST = 4.2 m of the ball at the event tick.
frozen.movingDenominatorDisclosure: ⭐ TWO denominators per face and BOTH published: `affectedBodiesInRelevance` (inside the relevance radius — the population the lags are measured on) and `affectedBodiesAllDistances` (every non-initiator body). Steering lags carry a THIRD, `steer.applicableBodies`, because the intercept family is a subset.

insertionSeamMap.method: each channel's needle is searched in the SHIPPED bytes at run time; the line number is whatever src says. A needle that vanishes fails gSeamMap.

channels.reads: the decision gate itself — the ONLY door to `decidePlayer` in the live path
channels.cadence: fires when the timer expires; re-armed to AI_INTERVAL = 0.15 sim-s
channels.note: A latency timer ANDed into this gate holds the whole decision layer at once. This is the cheapest single seam in the world, and it is already a latency structure.

channels.reads: nothing (a write) — the ordinary cadence re-arm
channels.cadence: every 0.15 sim-s per body, phase-staggered at kick-off
channels.note: The existing cadence IS an unearned latency of 0..9 ticks that every body already pays. PC-T0 composes with it, it does not replace it.

channels.reads: the body index — the kick-off phase of the cadence
channels.cadence: once, at kick-off
channels.note: Deterministic phase stagger: the 0..9-tick decision lag is a FIXED per-body offset, not a random one. The seam must not assume the offsets are uniform per event.

channels.reads: EVERY body, EVERY tick — the per-tick steering channel in full
channels.cadence: every tick (60 Hz sim)
channels.note: ⭐ THE LOAD-BEARING SEAM. The executor re-reads live truth for every body every tick; holding only the decision layer would leave steering omniscient (M-PC.2's own warning).

channels.reads: `ball.pos`, `ball.vel`, `ball.z`, `ball.vz`, `ball.spin` — the TRUTH ball
channels.cadence: every tick, for every body in ChaseBall / ReceivePass / InterceptPass
channels.note: The channel INFO-DOCTRINE §3 measured ("every defender re-targets the truth ball within 1 tick"). A frozen target here is the whole of M-PC.2 for the chase family.

channels.reads: `ball.owner` and the carrier's live position — the containment target
channels.cadence: every tick, for a goal-side chaser
channels.note: A SECOND truth read inside the same case: who owns the ball. A hold that freezes the intercept point but lets `ball.owner` through still leaks the turnover.

channels.reads: `ball.pos` (the ball-side lane blend) + the mark's live position
channels.cadence: every tick, for every body in MarkOpponent (25.99 % of all player-samples, R-甲 §2.0a)
channels.note: The single largest population by action share. Its ball term is exactly the "sees the new ball instantly" channel for bodies who are not chasing.

channels.reads: the mark's speed and the own-goal distance; freezes `target` into `p.markAnchor`
channels.cadence: re-reads on 0.20–0.45 sim-s (12–27 ticks) — NOT per tick
channels.note: ⭐⭐ THE PRECEDENT OF RECORD: a TARGET-HOLD with an attribute-scaled reaction lag already ships, in the exact form M-PC.2 specifies, and its band 0.20–0.45 sim-s BRACKETS the doctrine's two literature-traced tiers (0.2 / 0.4–0.5). It is narrow (sprinting mark, near own goal, non-carrier) and attribute-keyed, not book-keyed.

channels.reads: `ball.pos.x` and `ball.owner` — the offside-trap release condition
channels.cadence: every tick, for a trap-biased marker
channels.note: A THIRD live-truth read in MarkOpponent. The doctrine's primitive 5 (shared snapshot — one stale defender breaks the trap) is later slice; here it is only a read to hold.

channels.reads: the live flight solution — landing point and flight direction
channels.cadence: every tick, for the intended receiver of an airborne delivery
channels.note: A deflection mid-flight re-solves this the very next tick.

channels.reads: `ball` (the whole object) + `hasBall` (the possession flag)
channels.cadence: every tick, for MoveToFormationSpot / HoldPosition (26.83 % of player-samples)
channels.note: The shape itself slides with the ball every tick. A turnover therefore re-shapes both teams instantly today; this is where "the whole block reacts as one" comes from.

channels.reads: `ball` — the support geometry around the live carrier
channels.cadence: every tick, for SupportBallCarrier (6.23 % of player-samples)
channels.note: The attacking mirror of the marking stance.

channels.reads: `ball.pos` for both the positioning arc and the FACING
channels.cadence: every tick, for GoalkeeperPosition (14.15 % of ALL player-samples)
channels.note: ⭐ THE KEEPER IS THE MOST TRUTH-COUPLED BODY ON THE PITCH: his facing is literally a live pointer to the ball. `faceTarget` holds a LIVE REFERENCE (`Player.ts` says so), so a naive "freeze the vector" hold would still track — the hold must COPY.

channels.reads: `ball.pos` as the target directly
channels.cadence: every tick while rushing
channels.note: The doctrine's own 单刀 example (出击即承诺) lives here.

channels.reads: `match.possessionSide`, `ball.owner`, `ball.pos`, `match.dribbleTouch`, `match.pendingPass`, `match.phase`, the keeper's hold state
channels.cadence: TEAM_AI_INTERVAL = 0.4 sim-s per team (24 ticks), NOT per tick
channels.note: ⭐⭐ A TEAM-LEVEL channel with its own cadence and NO per-body timer. A per-body latency hold does not cover it: the team brain can re-assign a chaser while that body is still inside his own hold. PC-T0 must decide whether this channel holds too, or whether the body's hold overrides the assignment it receives.

channels.reads: the whole live world for the team layer (mode, press, chasers, overlapper)
channels.cadence: 0.4 sim-s
channels.note: The second existing latency tier in the world, above the per-body one.

channels.reads: nothing — a WRITE on the initiator's own release
channels.cadence: once, at the aimed touch-past release
channels.note: ⭐ THE BUILT EXEMPLAR of M-PC.4 (CB-AFTERMATH-POLISH §FIX-①, ruling #273 item 2): the knocker re-decides on the NEXT tick, self-initiated = zero latency. PC-T0 must leave this path latency-free BY NAME.

channels.reads: the capturer's own shooting range and whether he is re-collecting his own knock
channels.cadence: once, at every capture (`giveBall`)
channels.note: The capturer is the INITIATOR of his own capture and already pays a settle, not a perception cost. His VICTIM pays nothing today — that asymmetry is the census's point.

channels.reads: whether the capturer is a keeper with the ball at his feet
channels.cadence: once, at a keeper capture
channels.note: A keeper-specific shortening of the settle — an existing role-differentiated cadence constant, and therefore a place where a written role rule already exists (M-PC.3 bans ADDING more, it does not retro-remove this one).

channels.reads: the receiver's own nearest opponent + his team's tempo gene
channels.cadence: once, at a PRESSURED reception
channels.note: ⭐⭐ THE WORLD ALREADY MODULATES PROCESSING TIME BY PRESSURE — and in the OPPOSITE sign to the doctrine: a pressed receiver gets a SHORTER slot (0.07 s vs the 0.3 s settle) so he can ping it first-time. The cost is priced as AIM NOISE, not as lateness. PC-T0 must state how its latency law composes with this: a body cannot both be held for a reaction tier and be handed a rushed slot by the same pressure.

channels.reads: nothing — a WRITE on arrival
channels.cadence: once per substitution
channels.note: The idiom knock-and-go cites as its precedent. A body walking onto the pitch has nothing to react to, so its 0.05 is a SETTLE, not a reaction constant.

verdictLegend.HOLD-SUFFICIENT: a per-body TARGET-HOLD on this channel is sufficient — the channel is evaluated inside the body's own executor/decision call.
verdictLegend.HOLD-INSUFFICIENT: the channel is evaluated OUTSIDE the body's own call (team layer) — a per-body hold does not cover it; PC-T0 must rule on it explicitly.
verdictLegend.ALREADY-A-HOLD: the world already holds here; the new law composes with it rather than replacing it.
verdictLegend.INITIATOR-PATH: a self-initiated write — M-PC.4 says it stays latency-free.

yardstick.caveat: ⚠ A TRANSFERRED yardstick, not a measured PC threshold. L3's book had to ORDER two outcome rates; a PC recognition book only needs COVERAGE of a class (M-PC.3), which plausibly needs far fewer exposures. nonClaims: ⭐ INSTRUMENT-ONLY: nothing is armed, nothing is built, no seam acquires a caller, and `src/**` is byte-untouched.

The steering lag is measured on the INTERCEPT FAMILY only, because that is the family whose target the engine computes with a function this probe can call without copying a formula. MarkOpponent / formationSpot / support / GK channels are mapped BY TRACE, not by lag — their per-tick truth reads are quoted at file:line and asserted by gSeamMap.

The class predicates are STATE-TRANSITION detectors over public engine state, not engine callbacks. A class can therefore under- or over-count at the margin; each predicate is published verbatim so the count can be re-derived or disputed.
The exposure arithmetic uses LEAGUE fixtures only and ignores cup matches, so every seasons-to-fill figure is an upper bound.
No latency law is designed here and no tier is assigned. PC-T0 owns the seam.
